positive_claim: Fictional company reports 15% year-on-year profit growth; no consensus beat is asserted.

evidence.title: Synthetic earnings announcement
evidence.text: Net profit increased 15% year on year. Revenue increased 8%. No historical consensus dataset is supplied.

evidence.title: Synthetic margin guidance
evidence.text: Management lowered next-quarter gross margin guidance from 40% to 36%, citing input costs.

evidence.title: Synthetic demand counter-evidence
evidence.text: Management said demand remained stable and full-year revenue guidance was unchanged. This challenges a broad demand-collapse explanation but does not negate margin pressure.

evidence.title: Synthetic sector peers decline
evidence.text: The sector benchmark fell 2% over the same observation window; three peers declined between 1% and 3%.

evidence.title: Future sector margin story — excluded
evidence.text: A subsequent article attributes the decline to margin guidance. This was not available at the investigation cutoff.
